digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm review APIs and external integration tests
propositions: The public API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed pre-1.0 in favor of review_plan/review_code, but two external test modules (test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py) still call it, causing 4 CI lanes in the Live External Integration workflow to fail with AttributeError
External test modules are excluded from the standard Verified gate, so the removal epic's test suite never exercised them and the regression remained invisible until live workflow_dispatch execution
review_plan() cannot serve as a drop-in replacement because it returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT (no top-level findings key) whereas both tests expect REVIEW_RESULT with runner, model, and findings fields

Both external test modules were successfully retargeted to rebar.llm.review_code (the surviving API that returns REVIEW_RESULT with the required schema), preserving test assertions and enabling the four-pass gate via REBAR_VERIFY_ENABLE_CODE_REVIEW
Live workflow_dispatch validation confirmed external LLM (anthropic, openai, bedrock) and langfuse tracing lanes GREEN after the retarget; no review_ticket AttributeError occurrences remain
